title: XROS 5 Mini Kit – 2ml
description:
VAPORESSO XROS 5 MINI POD KIT

The VAPORESSO XROS 5 MINI POD KIT is a minimalist entry-level MTL device. Powered by COREX 3.0 Tech, it provides users with a more constant and stable, richer aroma reproduction, delicate flavor, and smoother vaping experience. It has a 1500mAh battery and supports 2A fast charging. Adjustable airflow allows for customization, and hidden tidal light strips can visualize the change in power level.

Features

- Corex 3.0 Tech

- Adjustable Power & Airflow

- Hidden Tidal LED Light

- XROS Series Pods Compatible

Specifications

- Dimensions: 110.5*24.2*14.1mm

- Output Power: 30W Max

- Pod Capacity: 2mL

- Battery Capacity: 1500mAh

- Charging: Type-C, 2A

Package List

- 1x VAPORESSO XROS 5 MINI POD KIT Device

- 1x VAPORESSO XROS REPLACEMENT POD (4 PACK) -0.8OHM (Pre-installed)

- 1x Type-C Charging Cable

- 1x Reminder Card

- 1x User Manual & Warranty Card
